name: tixly-server-side-tracking
description: Server-side tracking for Meta Conversions API and TikTok Events API

_envVarsRequired.META_PIXEL_ID: Facebook/Instagram Pixel ID from Meta Events Manager
_envVarsRequired.META_ACCESS_TOKEN: Meta Conversions API access token (System User token)
_envVarsRequired.META_TEST_EVENT_CODE: OPTIONAL — staging only, enables Meta test events (e.g. TEST12345)
_envVarsRequired.TIKTOK_PIXEL_CODE: TikTok Pixel code from TikTok Ads Manager
_envVarsRequired.DATABASE_URL: PostgreSQL connection string (must have tracking schema)
_envVarsRequired.REDIS_URL: Redis connection string for deduplication (default: redis://localhost:6379)
_envVarsRequired.INTERNAL_API_KEY: API key for DLQ management endpoints
